V02 · CELLS BECOME SCAFFOLDS

Three lozenge readings of one field · three derived levels

Actual shared seams create new neighbour edges. Complete interior vertex cycles create new cells, which can be read again. Finite boundary participation stays in an explicit complement at every level.

D1 and D2 are also rebuilt by acknowledged path flow. D3 is an observed native topology with a published word interpretation. None of these roles identifies its source sites or asserts a universal geometric centre.

What is defined here

A read is source + actual membership/relationship constraints + context + correspondence + complement. Names identify these definitions for discussion; they do not select their meaning. Authored grouping proposals are checked against actual source faces, seams and sites. This is symbolic derivation from existing Gojo structure, not blind image recognition or learned discovery.

The optional word-landmark read shares repeated participation in the declared additive basis. It retains its source bindings, share slots, calculation and any remainder. Equal spacing, metric centres and regular polygon angles are additional geometric claims. Three successive cell-incidence reads retain their finite boundary complements.
